messages.text: For the localization readout, I used the enterprise localization funnel, saved PostHog insight 55a0f90c-f0d3-504f-ae18-f8cbf87e80b3. September product copy: “Enterprise teams are moving from localization setup to publishing translated pages.” This is my shortened version of Alex’s localization readout note from yesterday.
I’ve changed the draft education tile to “Site-planning worksheet.” It still has the five open-ended questions, and I’ve removed the duration promise. Aaron, does that address your copy note?
Yes, that matches the worksheet. I’m happy with that label for the draft.

For the Localization Workflows query walkthrough, I’m keeping the page’s target locales as the starting set in this example. The wider catalog stays out of the missing-translation list. This remains a sketch.
I’ve kept both individual site directions beside the combined-count example in my walkthrough notes. I’m labeling it as a constructed fixture, so it won’t be mistaken for a customer traffic result.

Rachel, I’ve carried this line into the customer explanation of localization. The source link in my working copy opens the general month-end localization funnel, and I can’t tell what observation we originally meant. I’m leaving the passage in draft until we can put it in context.
